messages:
ashwin: quick heads-up — ran a 45B onboarding sweep (qint8) across H100 fleets in us-west and eu-west. pasting highlights and asking for Dedicated sizing recs
ashwin: us-west H100v2, conc=2 -> p50 62ms, p95 280ms, p99 520ms, throughput ~950 tok/s @512 tokens
ashwin: eu-west H100v2, conc=2 -> p50 80ms, p95 340ms, p99 610ms, throughput ~840 tok/s @512 tokens
ashwin: bumping conc to 4 raises throughput ~1.8x but p99 becomes bad (us-west p99 ~900ms). KV cache helps tail but not entirely
marie: ok. if our SLO is p95 <= 300ms and customer QPS is 120 req/s with avg response 512 tokens, rough token demand = 120 * 512 = 61,440 tok/s
marie: with ~950 tok/s per H100 (us-west), naive GPUs = 61,440 / 950 ≈ 65 GPUs. that's baseline without batching/caching optimizations
lucas: that number is high but expected for 45B and 512 token outputs. options: increase batching, enable prefix caching, or accept higher p95 during bursts. also consider regional split to reduce cross-region latency
anya: ops POV — recommend adding a 30% autoscale buffer and a small canary pool. suggests: canary 3-4 GPUs, min pool 50, max pool 130 for initial rollout
ashwin: quality note: int8 eval on our regression harness shows minor drift on long-dialog rouge (~1.8% drop). fallback path to fp16 is ready via model-variant routing
marie: kernel notes: fused-attn variant on H100 reduces p99 by ~10-15% compared to generic kernels in these runs. if fused kernel unavailable, fallback p99 rises ~80-100ms
lucas: small config snippet for autoscale we're thinking about:
```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 50
  target_tokens_per_gpu: 900
  buffer_pct: 30
  scale_cooldown_s: 120
  max_replicas: 130
```
marie: using target_tokens_per_gpu ~= 900 is conservative vs measured 950 to give headroom for kernel variability + eu-west degradation
dalia: ops question — how much warmup time to prefetch KV caches for steady state? canary needs prewarm sequence
ashwin: prewarm run showed useful cache warmth after ~20 minutes at steady QPS; suggest scheduled warmup job during deploy window
anya: can also enable short-lived burst capacity (2x) for 5-minute windows for scheduled marketing events; keep billing cap per customer
dalia: tagging infra — @infra-bot can you kick off the prewarm + canary deploy and reserve the initial pool counts?
infra-bot: scheduled — reserving 70 H100s in us-west and 12 H100s in eu-west for canary + min pool. canary deploy at 2162346200, warmup job queued. logs: https://internal/ci/2162345600/bench1
marie: recommendation summary: start Dedicated in us-west with 70 GPUs, eu-west 12 GPUs, autoscale max 130, canary 4 GPUs, buffer 30%. revisit after 24h telemetry (p95/p99 + token util)
lucas: +1 to that plan. also capture kernel usage and per-gpu token saturation metrics so we can refine target_tokens_per_gpu
ashwin: thanks — i'll run a second sweep adjusting conc knobs (1/2/4) and post updated tails. will also enable fallback routing to fp16 for safety
anya: :thumbsup:
marie: filing follow-up playbook items in the onboarding ticket and adding evals to alerting (quality + latency)
ashwin: great, will update ticket with final numbers after second run
marie: noted — tagging this for review in tomorrow sync
